hero.eyebrow: FOR AGENCIES & LEAD-GEN TEAMS RUNNING 5+ CLIENT ACCOUNTS
hero.sub: Stop rebuilding a Clay + HeyReach + ChatGPT + PhantomBuster stack for every client. Valley brings warm signals, qualification, prospect research, your client’s voice, and outreach into one workflow per client—so your team can spend more time on the conversations you’re paid to create.

margin.h2:
The retainer is yours.
The overhead shouldn’t eat it.
margin.lead: Every new account can mean another round of API keys, enrichment tables, prompt writing, and sequence setup. Multiply the maintenance by your client count, and the work starts competing with the service you actually sell.

cards.label: 01 / SETUP
cards.title: Win a client. Then onboard them again.
cards.body: API keys, Clay tables, sequence rebuilds, and tool connections add work before the first message goes out. Repeating that setup across five or ten accounts consumes the hours you could put into strategy and delivery.
cards.answer: Valley brings the steps together. Set the client’s audience, offer, and voice inside the same outbound workflow.

cards.label: 02 / RETENTION
cards.title: Your client buys conversations.
cards.body: Generic outreach is easy to send and hard to defend in a client review. When replies dry up, the agency has to explain what changed—and why the retainer is still worth paying.
cards.answer: Valley connects buying signals and prospect research to the message. Review what earns a reply and use that context to improve the next campaign.

cards.label: 03 / ACCOUNT CONTROL
cards.title: Their account. Your reputation.
cards.body: A client trusts your agency with their LinkedIn account and inbox. Sending more isn’t a strategy; the timing, audience, follow-ups, and replies all need a deliberate process.
cards.answer: Review messages, choose sequence timing, and work within sending limits. A reply stops the sequence so your team can take over the conversation.

workflow.h2:
Add the next client.
Not another stack to maintain.
workflow.lead: Keep the work that makes your agency valuable: the offer, the strategy, and the client relationship. Let Valley connect the research, writing, and follow-up behind it.

steps.title: A reason to reach out. For every client.
steps.body: Build each client’s audience from relevant buying signals, a play, or their own list. Valley qualifies prospects and researches the people worth reaching, so your team can spend less time assembling lists and more time refining the client’s offer.

steps.title: Their voice. Your agency’s standard.
steps.body: Give Valley the client’s offer, ideal customer, and writing style. Combine that voice with prospect-specific research, then review the messages before they go out. Each account gets its own context—not the same template with a different company name.

steps.title: Follow-through without the handoffs.
steps.body: Run LinkedIn and email sequences, manage replies, and review campaign results together. When a prospect replies, the sequence stops. Keep the research beside the conversation so your team can hand the client a useful next step, not another spreadsheet.

paths.h2:
Three ways to run client outbound.
Three very different workloads.
paths.lead: Compare what your team still has to do after choosing the software.

cards.label: PATH 01 / A SENDING TOOL
cards.title: HeyReach or Expandi
cards.line: Sending is covered. You do the rest.
cards.body: Your team finds prospects, researches each person and writes the messages.
cards.owns: List quality, personalization and the tools feeding the sender.

cards.label: PATH 02 / A DIY STACK
cards.title: A connected DIY stack
cards.line: Build it. Connect it. Maintain it.
cards.body: Trigify for signals. Clay for research. ChatGPT for drafts. A separate tool to send.
cards.owns: Integrations, subscriptions and troubleshooting for every client.

cards.label: PATH 03 / VALLEY
cards.title: One workflow per client
cards.line: The full workflow in one place.
cards.body: Find, qualify, research and message prospects. Keep replies and results with each campaign.
cards.owns: Client strategy, message approval and the next conversation.

budget.title: One seat per client. A clear starting cost.
